title: Admit an overridden head after repeated FAIL attempts
body:
Review engine judge 2026-10-29 on #135 code: with two FAIL attempts on the same head, krn review --override appends only to the latest record, while PR admission also reads records/1.json and refuses with "review panel is FAIL without override", leaving that head unadmittable.
Acceptance: admission evaluates the latest complete attempt on the exact head (earlier consumed attempts stay as history), or the override covers every FAIL attempt on that head; a frozen observer reproduces the dead end RED on base and GREEN on head.
